parameters.query:
=SELECT 
    painter_id,
    painter_name,
    painter_mobile,
    calculated_acceptance_rate,
    calculated_conversion_rate,
    calculated_availability_score,
    ((0.4 * calculated_acceptance_rate) + (0.4 * calculated_conversion_rate) + (0.2 * calculated_availability_score)) AS final_score,
    is_new_priority
FROM painter_matching_scores
WHERE retailer_id = '{{$node["Webhook - Assign Trigger"].json["body"]["retailer_id"]}}'
  AND painter_id NOT IN (
      SELECT painter_id 
      FROM lead_assignment_history 
      WHERE lead_id = '{{$node["Webhook - Assign Trigger"].json["body"]["lead_id"]}}'
  )
ORDER BY 
    is_new_priority DESC,
    final_score DESC,
    last_assigned_at ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

=UPDATE leads 
SET current_painter_id = '{{$node["Postgres - Select Match"].json["painter_id"]}}',
    current_status = 'ASSIGNED',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE lead_id = '{{$node["Webhook - Assign Trigger"].json["body"]["lead_id"]}}'
RETURNING lead_id;

=INSERT INTO lead_assignment_history (
    lead_id,
    painter_id,
    response_status,
    assigned_at
) VALUES (
    '{{$node["Webhook - Assign Trigger"].json["body"]["lead_id"]}}',
    '{{$node["Postgres - Select Match"].json["painter_id"]}}',
    'PENDING',
    NOW()
) RETURNING assignment_id;

=INSERT INTO lead_status_history (
    lead_id,
    old_status,
    new_status,
    remarks
) VALUES (
    '{{$node["Webhook - Assign Trigger"].json["body"]["lead_id"]}}',
    'CREATED',
    'ASSIGNED',
    'Auto-assignment engine matches painter'
) RETURNING status_history_id;

=INSERT INTO painter_performance (
    painter_id,
    allocated_sites,
    last_assigned_at,
    updated_at
) VALUES (
    '{{$node["Postgres - Select Match"].json["painter_id"]}}',
    1,
    NOW(),
    NOW()
) ON CONFLICT (painter_id) DO UPDATE SET
    allocated_sites = painter_performance.allocated_sites + 1,
    last_assigned_at = EXCLUDED.last_assigned_at,
    updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
RETURNING painter_id;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: "assigned", painter_id: ($node["Postgres - Select Match"].json["painter_id"] || null), painter_name: ($node["Postgres - Select Match"].json["painter_name"] || null), painter_mobile: ($node["Postgres - Select Match"].json["painter_mobile"] || null), final_score: ($node["Postgres - Select Match"].json["final_score"] || null) }) }}
